metadata.title: DUO icosahedral level 2 (N=320 cells, ~2800 km)
metadata.description: DUO triangular icosahedral mesh at subdivision level 2 (320 triangular cells, 162 vertices, 480 edges). Quasi-uniform global sphere; constant valence 3. Generated by build_duo_grid via the builtin icosahedral loader; no file I/O required.
